segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin or dry under-eyes report mixed results: some find it not moisturizing enough or fast to crease, while others say it noticeably smooths and hydrates dry under-eye areas.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive eyes or skin are split: many say it is exceptionally gentle and finally an eye cream that doesn't irritate them, while several others with self-identified non-sensitive or sensitive skin report burning, stinging, redness or rash.
segments.mature: Reviewers citing mature or aging skin (40s–60s) generally report visible improvement in fine lines, crow's feet and firmness, and value it as an affordable alternative to expensive eye creams.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visible reduction in fine lines, crow's feet, and improved firmness/plumpness over weeks to months of use; a few say they see no change or it's too soon to tell.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, smoothing and good under makeup without pilling; a minority find it not moisturizing enough, drying down flaky, or creasing under concealer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the cream caused redness, burning, bloodshot eyes, or a rash around the eyes, sometimes despite not normally having reactive skin; others explicitly report zero irritation or redness even with sensitive eyes.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention past dryness/flakiness or a compromised eye area improving with continued use, describing skin as more soft and velvety over time; no consistent reports of barrier damage aside from the irritation cases.
concerns.spots: One reviewer developed a stye near the lash line after applying too close to the lash pores, which resolved with more careful application; this is an isolated report.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports a breakout after a single use and discontinued the product; this is an isolated report with no other blemish complaints.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically discusses oiliness or oil control from this eye cream.

aspects.libelle: Wears well under makeup, no pilling
Good value versus expensive eye creams

extraits.texte: I was excited to try this because I love most other Naturium products I've used and I'm very loyal to the brand. This one burns my eyelids to the point where they keep burning for days after discontinuing use. I don't have sensitive skin, actually the opposite: my skin is very resilient. Instead I've had to use some soothing lotions for days after to stop the irritation. What a shame, I really wanted to love this.

I wanted to love this but unfortunately it caused major burning, sensitivity, redness and even peeling around the outer corners of my eyes. I've had to use aquaphor day and night to heal the damage it did to my skin.
I give it a few stars for the price, however, this eye cream is not moisturizing(I have dry skin). It also doesnt have a good slip or doesnt spread nicely on the skin.

extraits.titre: My favorite eye cream of all time!
extraits.texte: My eyes get dry and irritated easily, but this counteracts that quickly. It leaves the perfect finish—super hydrating, but not overly tacky or oily. It wears well under makeup and I can use it 2x/per day on my entire eye contour with zero irritation. I've seen a marked difference in fine lines as well. I've been through so many tubes. This formula is my ride or die. No other eye cream compares!

extraits.titre: Just as good as $100+ eye creams!
extraits.texte: My absolute favorite eye cream. As someone with incredibly reactive and sensitive skin, finding something that doesnt irritate me AND actually works is so hard. But this eye creams wins out over any others at this price, and I like it just as much as others I've used that are far more expensive.

I'm always on the hunt for a great eye cream for maturing skin. This product has been such a pleasant surprise! It shouldn't be, because I've yet to meet a Naturium product I haven't loved! The brand somehow provides a very upscale product line at the most reasonable prices. The packaging is perfection! A squeeze tube where I don't need to dip my finger into a pot? Sign me up! It's the perfect consistency and texture - not too thick but thick enough it feels super hydrating going on, and continues to provide moisture throughout the day. I've already purchased a backup - I even have my husband using it!
